source_layer: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, MapServer layer 28 (Flood Hazard Zones)
cell_context_method: NISAR-cell center point-in-polygon classification against downloaded FEMA NFHL polygons.
limitations: This is flood-zone context sampled at the aggregated radar-cell center; it is not a cell-area percentage, flood depth, parcel determination, or forecast.
A cell with no matching polygon is recorded as not mapped to an SFHA polygon by this layer, not as risk-free.
